name: Claim-to-Evidence Citation Binding
mechanism: Carries stable source and span identifiers through retrieval and requires each material answer claim to bind to evidence that entails it.
use_when: Users or auditors must verify claims against exact source regions
avoid_when: The task contains no external evidence
Stable source identities and retrievable spans cannot be preserved
expected_effects: Measurable citation completeness and attribution correctness
failure_modes: Citation laundering attaches a relevant source to unsupported prose
Correct support is cited at the wrong span or version
Over-citation obscures which source supports which claim
